questions.text: Is there a place for people to walk along this street?

options.text: No place to walk – pedestrians must walk on the road and step aside for passing vehicles
Shared pedestrian and bicycle path (shared-use path)
Walking area at the same level as the road

questions.text: Is the raised sidewalk protected from traffic by a physical barrier?

options.text: Yes, by planted strip / bushes / flower pots

questions.text: Does this walking path include a section where pedestrians must use stairs?

options.text: Only a few steps (up to about 10 steps)

questions.text: How is the walking area separated from traffic?
Are there any problems affecting the walking surface? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Sidewalk is tilted sideways and feels uncomfortable

questions.text: How easy is it for people to pass each other on this path?

options.text: Only one person can walk at a time
Two people can pass each other, but one usually needs to step aside
Two people can comfortably walk side by side
Small groups can comfortably pass each other
Very wide path with free pedestrian movement

questions.text: What usually causes this sidewalk to become busy or crowded? (Select all that apply)

options.text: People gathering outside shops, cafés, bars, or restaurants
People waiting at bus or public transport stops

questions.text: How often do you notice damaged areas on the walking surface (cracks, holes, uneven pavement, flooding spots)?
What obstacles make you change your walking path? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Bicycles, e-scooters, or motorcycles parked on the sidewalk
Trees, poles, signs, or utility boxes
Shop displays, merchandise, or street vendors
Water dripping from roofs, air conditioners, or gutters

questions.text: How often do obstacles block or reduce the walking space?
Which accessibility features are available? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Tactile paving for visually impaired people
Street furniture that supports accessibility (e.g. benches, resting places)

fa.#Yes, by planted strip / bushes / flower: بله، با نوار سبز، بوته یا گلدان
fa.#Does this walking path include a sectio: آیا در این مسیر پیاده بخشی وجود دارد که عابران مجبور به استفاده از پله باشند؟
